top_signals.title: UK Long-Term Borrowing Costs Hit 6% for First Time Since 1998
top_signals.summary: The UK’s long-term borrowing costs hit 6% for the first time in almost three decades as concerns about entrenched inflation and mounting government debt burdens lifted yields globally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: TPG Raises $10 Billion for 2nd Private Equity Climate Fund
top_signals.summary: TPG Inc. has raised $10 billion in investor capital for a second private equity fund dedicated to climate strategies, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
